title: Task execution location
description: Canonical TaskInfo executionLocation projection. Runtime process and fenced lease facts describe actual ownership; configuredRunnerId is routing context only.

state.description: Operator-facing execution and health state. remote-disconnected is a quiet heartbeat under a still-valid lease; remote-stale is a run no authority covers any more.

executionKind.description: Actual location kind, or none when no runtime owns the task.

runnerId.description: Stable identity of the actual lease or process owner.

clientId.description: Task API client identity associated with the owner.

hostDisplayName.description: Human-readable execution host or runner name.

configuredRunnerId.description: Project routing target. This never overrides actual runtime ownership.

startedAt.description: Current or captured run start time.

lastActivityAt.description: Latest runtime, client, or task activity signal.

processId.description: Host-scoped process identity when safe to expose.

worktreePath.description: Task or run worktree provenance path.

connectionState.description: Connected, disconnected, queued, recovering, historical, or none.

leaseState.description: Active, expired, released, local-process, or none.

trustReason.description: Explanation of which authoritative runtime fact supports the projection.

historical.description: True for captured settled run attribution, which must render quietly.

lastRunnerEvent.description: Last runner event the server can name, shown for a disconnected or stale remote run. Null while the run is live.

lastRejection.description: Latest remote Runner refusal recorded during the task's current Ready-lane stay. Null when no current refusal exists.
